subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should Feishu pacing be an automatic provider-owned 5-QPS safeguard, or a new opt-in channel/account configuration that leaves existing behavior unpaced by default?
rationale: The official API publishes a stable per-target limit, while repository policy strongly prefers product/provider defaults over new configuration; choosing the permanent operator contract requires Feishu-owner intent.

options.title: Use automatic provider pacing
options.body: Apply a 200 ms per-account-and-target minimum by default, retain retry for residual limits, and avoid adding a new public setting unless later evidence requires one.

options.title: Approve the opt-in setting
options.body: Keep both configuration locations and the zero default, but require complete docs, generated metadata, upgrade/fresh-install coverage, and live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Retain retry only
options.body: Decline proactive pacing and close or narrow this PR, accepting that bursts may first encounter Feishu rate-limit responses handled by the existing retry path.

recommendation.title: Use automatic provider pacing
recommendation.body: Apply a 200 ms per-account-and-target minimum by default, retain retry for residual limits, and avoid adding a new public setting unless later evidence requires one.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package identifies this handle as its community maintenance contact and the decision concerns the plugin's public configuration and delivery policy.
